title: What the Decision Turned On

scenario.en: A colleague missed the meeting where a supplier was chosen and believes it was decided on price. It was not.
scenario.ar: زميلك محضرش الاجتماع اللي اختاروا فيه المورّد وفاهم إن السعر هو اللي حكم. مش صح.

source: Minutes: 'It was not the price that decided the matter, although Meridian was marginally cheaper. What proved decisive was delivery: Meridian could not commit before week 14, and the crux was that our own deadline is week 11. The point several members emphasised was that a late delivery costs more than the saving. Above all, the committee wanted a supplier who would accept a penalty clause, and only Castell agreed to one. Worth noting: the quality assessments were judged equivalent.'

task.en: Correct your colleague's understanding and tell him precisely what the decision rested on.
task.ar: صحّح فهم زميلك وقول له القرار اتخذ على أساس إيه بالظبط.

key_points.en: Price did not decide it, although Meridian was slightly cheaper.
key_points.ar: السعر مش هو اللي حكم، رغم إن ميريديان كانت أرخص شوية.

key_points.en: Delivery was decisive: Meridian could not commit before week 14 and our deadline is week 11.
key_points.ar: التسليم كان الفاصل: ميريديان مش قبل أسبوع 14 وموعدنا أسبوع 11.

key_points.en: Only Castell accepted a penalty clause.
key_points.ar: كاستل بس هي اللي قبلت شرط الغرامة.

key_points.en: Quality was judged equivalent between them.

model_answer.en: It was not price. Meridian was marginally cheaper, and quality was judged equivalent, so neither settled it. What was decisive was delivery: Meridian could not commit before week 14 and our deadline is week 11, and a late delivery costs more than the saving. The other factor was that only Castell accepted a penalty clause.
model_answer.ar: مكانش السعر. ميريديان كانت أرخص شوية والجودة اتقيّمت متساوية، فمحدش منهم حسم. الفاصل كان التسليم: ميريديان مش قبل أسبوع 14 وموعدنا أسبوع 11، والتأخير بيكلّف أكتر من الوفر. والعامل التاني إن كاستل بس قبلت شرط الغرامة.

signal_phrases.en: Am I right in thinking that?
